archive.catalogue_description: Cryogenic is a very fast paced I made just for fun. There is a lot of space to run around and there are some cool camping spots to eliminate endless zombie hordes. Since this is my first map there are going to be some bugs, but I do not plan to continue working on this map anymore since I just want to start on a brand new one. I really hope you guys enjoy this!
